# Selection of Regions/Lobes

## 0. Data and libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(BBmisc)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(cluster)
library(stringr)
library(factoextra)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
library(emmeans)
library(influence.ME)
library(rstatix)
library(ggridges)
```

Summary statistics:

```{r}
lobes_sum <- read.csv("Output/Components_Lobes/summary_statistics.csv")
lobes_sum <- lobes_sum[c(1:16,41:48),]
```

```{r}
surface_sum <- read.csv("Output/Area/summary_statistics.csv")
thickness_sum <- read.csv("Output/Thickness/summary_statistics.csv")
```

```{r}
sum_stat <- rbind(lobes_sum,surface_sum)
sum_stat <- rbind(sum_stat,thickness_sum)
```

## 1. Cohen's D

Select region with absolute threshold of 0.5

```{r}
selected_regions <- sum_stat$Region[abs(sum_stat$Patient.Cohen.s.d) > 0.5]
```

=\> 6 regions have an effect size larger than 0.5 (medium)

## 2. Visualize selected regions

```{r}
surface_z <- read.csv("Output/Area/zscores.csv")
surface_z$group <- as.factor(surface_z$group)
thickness_z <- read.csv("Output/Thickness/zscores.csv")
thickness_z$group <- as.factor(thickness_z$group)

surface_z <- surface_z[,c("SubjectID", "age", "sex", "group","lh_parstriangularis_area")]
thickness_z <- thickness_z[,c("SubjectID","lh_frontalpole_thickness","lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness","lh_superiorparietal_thickness","rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness","rh_superiorparietal_thickness")]
```

```{r}
selected_z <- merge(surface_z,thickness_z,by="SubjectID")
```

```{r}
selected_z_long <- selected_z %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(5:10),
    names_to = "Region",
    values_to = "Zscore"
  )

mycols <- c(
  "lh_parstriangularis_area"           = "#e40303",  # blue
  "lh_frontalpole_thickness"           = "#ff8c00",  # bluish green
  "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness"  = "#ffed00",  # orange
  "lh_superiorparietal_thickness"      = "#008026",  # vermillion
  "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness"   = "#004dff", 
  "rh_superiorparietal_thickness"      = "#750787"
)
```

```{r}
# Split into HC and Patient
df_HC <- selected_z_long %>% filter(group == "HC")
df_Patient <- selected_z_long %>% filter(group == "Patient")

ridge_plot <- ggplot() +

  # --- 1. HC layer (GRAY) ---
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_HC,
    aes(
      x = Zscore,
      y = Region,
      group = Region
    ),
    fill = "#a6c3ce",
    color = "#a6c3ce",
    alpha = 0.5,
    scale = 0.9,
    rel_min_height = 0.01
  ) +

  # --- 2. Patient layer (REGION COLOR) ---
  geom_density_ridges(
    data = df_Patient,
    aes(
      x = Zscore,
      y = Region,
      fill = Region,
      color = Region,
      group = Region
    ),
    alpha = 0.8,
    scale = 0.9,
    rel_min_height = 0.01
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1.96,
    color = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = -1.96,
    color = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = mycols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mycols) +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Z-scores") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(selected_regions),
    labels = c(
      "lh_parstriangularis_area"           = "Left pars triangularis (SA)",
      "lh_frontalpole_thickness"           = "Left frontal pole (CT)",
      "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness"  = "Left lateral orbitofrontal (CT)",
      "lh_superiorparietal_thickness"      = "Left superior parietal (CT)",
      "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness"   = "Right caudal middle frontal (CT)",
      "rh_superiorparietal_thickness"      = "Right superior parietal (CT)"
    )
  )

ridge_plot
```

```{r}
write.csv(selected_z,"Results/Risk_Factors/Selected_regions_z.csv")
```
